description: Source code for fake remoting components in media remoting, including classes FakeRemotingDataStreamSender, FakeRemoter, and FakeRemoterFactory, used for testing media remoting functionality.

classes.name: FakeRemotingDataStreamSender
classes.description: Simulates a data stream sender for remoting, managing buffer reading and frame validation.

classes.name: FakeRemoter
classes.description: Simulates a remoter for testing remoting start, stop, and data stream handling.

classes.name: FakeRemoterFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create FakeRemoter instances and controller for testing.

methods.name: FakeRemotingDataStreamSender::ResetHistory
methods.description: Resets internal counters and clears received frame list.

methods.name: FakeRemotingDataStreamSender::ValidateFrameBuffer
methods.description: Validates the frame buffer at a given index against expected size, key frame status, and pts.

methods.name: FakeRemotingDataStreamSender::CloseDataPipe
methods.description: Closes the data pipe and resets buffer reader.

methods.name: FakeRemotingDataStreamSender::SendFrame
methods.description: Sends a frame buffer through the data stream.

methods.name: FakeRemotingDataStreamSender::OnFrameRead
methods.description: Callback invoked when a frame is read, storing it and invoking the send callback.

methods.name: FakeRemotingDataStreamSender::CancelInFlightData
methods.description: Increments the counter for canceled in-flight data.

methods.name: FakeRemoter::Start
methods.description: Starts the remoting process, either successfully or failing based on configuration.

methods.name: FakeRemoter::StartWithPermissionAlreadyGranted
methods.description: Starts remoting assuming permission is already granted.

methods.name: FakeRemoter::StartDataStreams
methods.description: Initializes data stream senders for audio and video.

methods.name: FakeRemoter::Stop
methods.description: Stops remoting with a specified reason.

methods.name: FakeRemoter::SendMessageToSink
methods.description: Sends a message to the remoting sink (no-op in fake).

methods.name: FakeRemoter::Started
methods.description: Callback when remoting has started, notifies the source.

methods.name: FakeRemoter::StartFailed
methods.description: Callback when remoting start fails, notifies the source.

methods.name: FakeRemoter::Stopped
methods.description: Callback when remoting stops, notifies the source.

methods.name: FakeRemoterFactory::Create
methods.description: Creates a FakeRemoter instance and binds it to a receiver.

methods.name: FakeRemoterFactory::CreateController
methods.description: Creates a RendererController with a FakeRemoter for testing.
